description: This file is a shell script designed to process and organize valgrind error reports. It reads the output files generated by valgrind tests, groups errors, and manages error messages and backtraces for further analysis.

methods.name: start_output
methods.description: Initializes output for a new valgrind error, creating message files and updating error counts.

methods.name: finish_output
methods.description: Finalizes output for a current valgrind error, copying message files if multiple errors are grouped.

methods.name: output_all
methods.description: Aggregates and sorts error backtraces, printing grouped errors with their corresponding messages.

methods.name: handle_one
methods.description: Processes individual valgrind output files, parses error backtraces, and manages error message recording.
